agent_id.description: Unique identifier for this L3 agent instance (must be unique across all agents in the deployment).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output for troubleshooting.

state_sync_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between state syncs with the Neutron server. Lower values improve responsiveness but increase load.

max_routers_per_agent.description: Maximum number of routers this agent will manage. Set to 0 for unlimited. Helps distribute load across agents.

external_network_bridge.description: Bridge name used for external network traffic. Empty string uses the default bridge (e.g., br-ex).

enable_nat.description: Enable NAT for internal-to-external network translation (required for floating IPs and SNAT).

num_router_agents.description: Number of parallel worker processes for router processing. Increase under high router load.

ha.description: Enable high availability (HA) for routers using keepalived. Requires shared storage or database replication.

ha_network_name.description: Name of the Neutron network used for HA heartbeat traffic when HA mode is enabled.

ha_network_mtu.description: MTU (in bytes) for the HA network interface. Should account for overhead (e.g., 1500 - 50 for VXLAN).

gateway_external_device.description: Physical interface (e.g., 'eth0') bound to gateway router. Required for SNAT/DNAT when not using OVS.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 router advertisements and ND support.

report_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between agent heartbeats to the Neutron server. Shorter intervals improve failover detection.

min_restart_interval.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between agent restarts. Prevents thrashing during rapid failures.

keepalived_max_retries.description: Max attempts to restart keepalived before marking the router as failed (used only when ha=true).

keepalived_restart_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) between keepalived restart attempts (used only when ha=true).

external_networks.description: List of external network configurations (one per external network). Each defines bridge, gateway, and optional VLAN tag.

name.description: Logical name for this external network (used in comments only).

bridge.description: Linux bridge interface name for this external network (e.g., 'br-ex' or 'br-eth0').

gateway.description: Gateway IP address (CIDR notation) for this external network (e.g., '192.168.1.1/24').

vlan.description: VLAN ID for trunked external networks (optional).
